name: ybex-android
description: Ybex Android app (Capacitor shell, v364). Carries the web build inside the app so it opens offline. See README.md.

scripts.web: cd .. && VITE_API_ORIGIN=${VITE_API_ORIGIN:-https://ybexapp.ai.studio} npx vite build && node scripts/ota-bundle.mjs
scripts.version: node -e "const fs=require('fs');try{const l=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('../dist/client/ota/latest.json','utf8'));const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('capacitor.config.json','utf8'));c.plugins.CapacitorUpdater.version=l.version;fs.writeFileSync('capacitor.config.json',JSON.stringify(c,null,2)+'\n');console.log('[android] built-in web version:',l.version)}catch(e){console.warn('[android] built-in version not set:',e.message)}"
scripts.sync: npm run web && npm run version && npx cap sync android
